question: If I have fewer than three cards in my graveyard and no Food on the battlefield, can I still choose to forage?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if you cannot pay either way, you cannot choose to forage.
expected.answer: If you don't have enough cards in your graveyard or a Food on the battlefield, you can't choose to forage.
